rem Angular Bisectors
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=257
rem Count the integer sided triangles
rem a <= b <= c of perimeter up to Limit
rem for which area(ABC) / area(AEG) is
rem an integer, E, F, G being the points
rem where the bisectors of C, A and B
rem meet the sides AB, BC and CA

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 100000000

rem The ratio is k = (a + b)(a + c) / (b
rem c), between 1 and 4, and a (a + b +
rem c) = (k - 1) b c. For k = 4 only
rem equilateral triangles qualify. For k
rem = 2, 3 write m = k - 1, b = h y and
rem m b - a = h d with h = gcd(b, m b -
rem a). Then a = h (m y - d) and c = a
rem ((m + 1) y - d) / d, where y and d
rem are coprime and h is a multiple t of
rem its least value d / gcd(d, m (m +
rem 1)). Each triangle is found once;
rem its multiples number Limit //
rem perimeter.
Total = Limit // 3
Top = (5 * Limit) isqrt + 2
for M in 1 to 2
  Mm = M * (M + 1)
  for Y in 1 to Top
    First = 1 + (M - 1) * Y
    for D in First to (M * Y - 1)
      G1 = Y
      G2 = D
      for
        if G2 equal 0
          break
        end
        T = G1 mod G2
        G1 = G2
        G2 = T
      end
      if G1 equal 1
        E1 = D
        E2 = Mm
        for
          if E2 equal 0
            break
          end
          T = E1 mod E2
          E1 = E2
          E2 = T
        end
        Hs = D // E1
        A0 = M * Y - D
        Cn = Hs * A0 * ((M + 1) * Y - D)
        if Cn mod D equal 0
          C1 = Cn // D
          A1 = Hs * A0
          B1 = Hs * Y
          Per = A1 + B1 + C1
          Ord = A1 at most B1
          Ord = Ord and (B1 at most C1)
          Tri = A1 + B1 greater C1
          Tri = Tri and (C1 greater A1)
          Fits = Per at most Limit
          if Ord and Tri and Fits
            Total += Limit // Per
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

  for G in 1 to Mm
    if Mm mod G not equal 0
      continue
    end
    K = Mm // G

        if Q gcd (K * Y) equal 1
          Per = Y * (K * Y - M * Q)
          Total += Limit // Per
        end
      end
    end
  end

rem Angular Bisectors
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=257
use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 100000000

rem M is the area ratio minus one.
rem Put G = gcd(D, M (M + 1)), D = G Q
rem and K = M (M + 1) // G. A primitive
rem triangle needs gcd(Y, G) = 1 and
rem gcd(Q, K Y) = 1, with perimeter
rem Y (K Y - M Q). Side ordering and the
rem strict triangle inequality bound Q;
rem the perimeter bound raises its start.
rem Root is ceil(sqrt((M + 1) Y^2)),
rem exact because M + 1 is 2 or 3.
Total = Limit // 3
for M in 1 to 2
  Mm = M * (M + 1)
  for G in 1 to Mm
    if Mm mod G not equal 0
      continue
    end
    K = Mm // G
    Top = ((G * Limit) // M) isqrt
    for Y in 1 to Top
      Root = ((M + 1) * Y * Y) isqrt + 1
      if M * Y * Root greater G * Limit
        break
      end
      if Y gcd G not equal 1
        continue
      end
      Ky = K * Y
      First = (M * Y) // (2 * G) + 1
      Bound = (Ky - Limit // Y + M - 1) // M
      if Bound greater First
        First = Bound
      end
      Last = ((M + 1) * Y - Root) // G
      for Q in First to Last
        if Q gcd Ky equal 1
          Per = Y * (Ky - M * Q)
          Total += Limit // Per
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
